initial_delta.note: The recipient list in the Lampiran is not copied. Whether the body receiving the payment is listed and not delisted is read from the case attribute employer('zakat_recipient_listed'); when it is False, the deduction is set to zero, overriding REG.ZAKAT.DEDUCTIBLE.2025. The start date 1 March 2026 is the first day of the tax period that contains the effective (signing) date of 30 March 2026.

delta.note: PER-4/PJ/2026 only replaces the list of bodies that may receive deductible zakat or mandatory religious contributions and repeals PER-6/PJ/2011 and PER-04/PJ/2022. It does not change how PPh 21 is computed, since REG.ZAKAT.DEDUCTIBLE.2025 already deducts zakat paid through the employer and the KB does not model which recipient is used, so no record is added.

output.reason: The regulation replaces PER-04/PJ/2022 (as amended) with a new consolidated list of government-approved zakat and mandatory religious donation recipients. Zakat or mandatory religious donations that permanent employees pay through their employer are deductible from gross income in the PPh 21 computation, but only when paid to a listed body. The new list (which includes bodies approved up to February 2026) therefore changes which payments qualify for that deduction. It also adds a new rule: payments made to a body after its operational licence is revoked and it is delisted are not deductible. Relevance is borderline, since the document only updates the recipient list and does not change any rate or table. The effective date is the signing date, 30 March 2026; I mapped this to the first day of that tax period, 1 March 2026.
